{{Quote|I'm calling about the agreement. I'm ready for Viamarr to become a signatory. A proud signatory.|Governor Watesk to Garik Loran|<ref name="ws" />}}
'''Watesk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Viamarr 4]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Um, I am Governor Watesk. I would very much like to speak with Captain Darillian.|Governor Watesk to Garik Loran|<ref name="ws" />}}
Shortly after the [[Bacta War]], Watesk entered into an agreement with [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] where [[Viamarr 4]] would provide one-tenth of supplies equivalent to their exports in exchange for protection. They would also provide information regarding their dealings with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the other warlords. And besides it all, a piece of land was to be given to Zsinj under an assumed name.<ref name="ws" />

When the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']], which was commandeered by [[Wraith Squadron]], paid a visit to the planet, Watesk unintentionally revealed all his dealings to a disguised [[Garik Loran]].<ref name="ws" />
